summary: This note describes "Dunn Dunn", a song produced by Born Immaculate and DJ Pooh that is the second single from Shawty Lo's debut solo album "Units in the City". It notes that a portion of Shawty Lo's third single "Foolish" is played at the end of the track, and that the video ends with "to be continued" on screen.
one_line: "Dunn Dunn" is the second single from Shawty Lo's debut solo album "Units in the City", produced by Born Immaculate and DJ Pooh.
key_facts: "Dunn Dunn" was produced by Born Immaculate and DJ Pooh.
"Dunn Dunn" is the second single from Shawty Lo's debut solo album "Units in the City".
Part of Shawty Lo's third single, "Foolish", is played at the end of "Dunn Dunn".
At the end of the "Dunn Dunn" video, "to be continued" is seen on the screen.
